svg.text: Net labels with the same name are connected. ● = junction. × = not connected. Orange = new metal-detector circuit, grey = pins freed by the port.
ECHO is 5 V → D12 is 5 V-tolerant
Diode: PN2222 base–collector junction (B = anode, C = cathode, E open),
or a 1N4007 (slower, less sensitive). Both from the ELEGOO starter kits.
Mount the coil on a foam-board boom ≥10 cm ahead of the motors,
1–2 cm above the floor and below the sonar beams.
USB-C PD cable → UNO Q USB-C
One ground for everything. SW1 = motor kill switch. WAGO 221s to split +5V_MOT/GND.
Webcam option: power UNO Q from its 5V pin instead and plug the camera into USB-C.
Replaces HC-05 — D0/D1 are now free · see architecture diagram
• 3.3 V logic: L298N inputs and HC-SR04 TRIG accept it;
nothing 5 V goes to A0/A1 (not 5 V-tolerant).
• HC-SR04 VCC now on +5V (a 3.3 V pin can't power it) → D5, D8 freed.
• Don't call pinMode() on PWM pins — analogWrite() sets them up.
• Same pin numbers as the adapted Uno sketch otherwise.
• Retune METAL_PULSES: the coil is now pulsed at 3.3 V.
